introduction: The `af` CLI agentic optimization wires all `af` commands to the unified `agentfox/io/` terminal IO module from spec 03, adds JSONL streaming progress events for long-running commands, and removes legacy compatibility shims to ensure consistent, machine-readable output across every subcommand.

glossary.AF_AGENT: Environment variable (`AF_AGENT=1`) that signals the CLI is running inside an agent harness, enabling machine-readable output defaults.
glossary.AgentFoxGroup: A Click Group subclass from `agentfox/io/` that provides unified error handling, `AF_AGENT` detection, and structured `--json --help` output.
glossary.BannerGroup: A legacy Click Group subclass in `af/__init__.py` superseded by `AgentFoxGroup`.
glossary.JSONL: JSON Lines format — one JSON object per line — used for streaming progress events to stderr.
glossary.OutputManager: The shared output dispatch class from `agentfox/io/` (spec 03) that routes data to human-readable or JSON format based on the active mode.
glossary.ProgressDisplay: The class responsible for showing task progress; updated in this spec to call `emit_progress()` in JSON mode.
glossary.af code: The `af` CLI subcommand that runs an agentic coding session; a long-running command that benefits from JSONL streaming.
glossary.af init: The `af` CLI subcommand that initializes the project configuration; previously emitted unstructured text in JSON mode.
glossary.af night-shift: The `af` CLI subcommand that runs overnight batch agentic work; a long-running command that benefits from JSONL streaming.
glossary.af standup: The `af` CLI subcommand that generates a standup summary; previously emitted unstructured text in JSON mode.
glossary.af/app.py: The main Click application entry point for the `af` CLI.
glossary.af/json_io.py: The legacy compatibility shim module inside the `af` package that re-exported symbols from `agentfox/io/`; deleted in this spec.
glossary.agentfox.io: The unified terminal IO package created in spec 03, providing `OutputManager`, `AgentFoxGroup`, error envelopes, and help rendering.
glossary.emit_progress: A method on `OutputManager` that writes JSONL progress event lines to stderr when `json_mode=True`.
glossary.exit_codes: A metadata decorator from `agentfox/io/help.py` that annotates a Click command with its possible exit codes for structured help rendering.
glossary.format_table: A utility function added to `agentfox/io/output.py` that renders tabular data consistently for both human and JSON output modes.
glossary.handle_agent_fox_errors: A legacy error-handling decorator in `af/__init__.py` superseded by `AgentFoxGroup`'s built-in error handling.
glossary.json_mode: The runtime flag indicating that the CLI should produce JSON/JSONL output instead of human-readable text; activated by the `--json` flag or `AF_AGENT=1`.
glossary.node_id: A dot-notation task identifier (e.g. `1.1`) used in JSONL progress events to reference a specific task node in the execution plan.
glossary.om.emit: The `OutputManager.emit()` method used to dispatch data output in either human-readable or JSON format.
glossary.task_completed: A JSONL progress event type emitted when a task node finishes successfully.
glossary.task_failed: A JSONL progress event type emitted when a task node fails.
glossary.task_started: A JSONL progress event type emitted when a task node begins execution.

correctness_properties.title: stdout/stderr separation for JSONL streaming commands
correctness_properties.for_any: invocation of `af code` or `af night-shift` with `--json`
correctness_properties.invariant: every line written to stdout is valid JSON and every line written to stderr is a valid JSONL progress event; no JSONL event lines appear on stdout and no final result JSON appears on stderr

correctness_properties.title: No af.json_io references in the af package
correctness_properties.invariant: the string `af.json_io` does not appear as an import path in any source file, and the file `af/json_io.py` does not exist

correctness_properties.title: OutputManager is sole data output channel
correctness_properties.invariant: `om.emit()` is the only mechanism used to write data output; no subcommand calls `click.echo` directly for data payloads

correctness_properties.title: JSON mode produces valid JSON on stdout
correctness_properties.invariant: stdout contains only valid JSON text; the process exits with code 0 on success

correctness_properties.title: format_table header-row alignment
correctness_properties.for_any: call to `format_table(headers, rows, json_mode)` where rows is non-empty
correctness_properties.invariant: every dict in the returned list (when `json_mode` is True) has exactly the same set of keys as the `headers` list

execution_paths.title: Agent invokes af code with --json and observes JSONL progress

steps.action: Invokes `af code --json` targeting a project
Routes the command through `AgentFoxGroup`, sets `json_mode=True` on `OutputManager`, stores it in `ctx.obj["output"]`
Retrieves `OutputManager` from `ctx.obj["output"]` and instantiates `ProgressDisplay` with `json_mode=True`
Calls `emit_progress()` with a `task_started` event for the first `node_id`, writing one JSONL line to stderr
Calls `emit_progress()` with `task_completed` or `task_failed` for each task node as it finishes, writing one JSONL line per event to stderr
Calls `om.emit()` with the final result dict after all tasks complete
Writes the final JSON result object to stdout and exits with code 0

execution_paths.title: Developer invokes af standup --json and receives structured output

steps.action: Invokes `af standup --json`
Sets `json_mode=True`, creates `OutputManager`, stores in `ctx.obj["output"]`
Retrieves `OutputManager` from `ctx.obj["output"]`, builds standup data
Calls `format_table()` for any tabular sections with `json_mode=True`
Calls `om.emit()` with the complete structured standup dict
Writes a single valid JSON object to stdout; exits with code 0

execution_paths.title: Agent requests JSON help output for af night-shift

steps.action: Invokes `af night-shift --json --help`
Detects both `--json` and `--help` flags; activates JSON help renderer
Reads command metadata including name, docstring, Click options, and `@exit_codes` decorator
Serialises metadata to a JSON object and writes it to stdout
Exits with code 0 without executing the command body

execution_paths.title: Developer verifies af/json_io.py shim is fully removed

steps.action: Runs `grep -r 'af.json_io' af/` in the repository
Returns no matches, confirming no remaining references to the deleted shim
Attempts `python -c 'import af.json_io'`
Raises `ModuleNotFoundError`, confirming the shim is deleted

execution_paths.title: Human developer invokes af standup without --json and sees Rich table

steps.action: Invokes `af standup` without any `--json` flag
Sets `json_mode=False`, creates `OutputManager` in text mode
Calls `format_table()` with `json_mode=False` to build a Rich table
Calls `om.emit()` with the Rich-rendered output
Renders the Rich table to stdout in human-readable format; exits with code 0

error_handling.condition: Unhandled exception propagates from any `af` subcommand
error_handling.behavior: `AgentFoxGroup` catches the exception and emits a structured JSON error envelope to stderr, then exits with a non-zero code

error_handling.condition: `AgentFoxGroup` cannot be imported from `agentfox.io` at module load time
error_handling.behavior: Python raises `ImportError` at import time with a message referencing `agentfox.io`

error_handling.condition: `ctx.obj["output"]` is None or missing when a subcommand attempts to retrieve `OutputManager`
error_handling.behavior: The subcommand raises `RuntimeError` with a descriptive message before attempting any output

error_handling.condition: stderr write fails during `emit_progress()` (e.g. broken pipe)
error_handling.behavior: The IO error is suppressed and command execution continues without crashing

error_handling.condition: `node_id` is None or empty when a JSONL progress event is about to be emitted
error_handling.behavior: The JSONL event is emitted with `"node_id": null` and a warning is logged to stderr

error_handling.condition: External code attempts to `import af.json_io` after the shim is deleted
A command function lacks the `@exit_codes` decorator when `--json --help` is requested
error_handling.behavior: JSON help renderer emits the help object with an empty `exit_codes` array; no exception is raised

error_handling.condition: `format_table()` is called with an empty rows list
error_handling.behavior: Returns an empty list (JSON mode) or an empty Rich table (text mode) without raising an exception

error_handling.condition: A row passed to `format_table()` contains fewer values than the number of headers
error_handling.behavior: Missing values are padded with `None` (JSON mode) or empty string (text mode); no exception is raised
